messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 Alert — unusual cross-region routing. Elevated 5xx rate for inference-api for requests originating in eu-west-1 that are being routed to us-east-1. Error spike started ~03:15 UTC. Auto-fallback to us-east observed. Paging @lee (oncall-sre) and @maria (neteng).

lee (oncall-sre): Ack. I'm on it — switching to incident channel. Can someone post a quick summary of the client-visible impact?

maria (neteng): Seeing a config rollout to route-policy-v2 at 03:13 UTC. Policy changed latency thresholds and introduced a new prefix-precedence rule. Early hypothesis: policy precedence made eu-west->us-east pinning weaker, so traffic rebalanced to us-east for many customers.

lee (oncall-sre): Good catch. Jin, did we have a canary for route-policy-v2?

jin (prod-eng): Canary was 1% for 10m. Telemetry shows the policy pushed wider than expected — the rollouter loop retried and expanded due to a leader election glitch. I'm rolling it back now.

maria (neteng): Repro steps/quick checks:
```
# from eu-west edge
curl -sS -D - https://inference.redwood.ai/health | grep X-Region-Pin
X-Region-Pin: us-east-1
# traceroute shows next hop through us-east-lb
traceroute to inference.redwood.ai (x.x.x.x), 30 hops max
 1  eu-edge-1 (10.20.1.1)  1.2 ms
 2  backbone (54.x.x.x)  10.4 ms
 3  us-east-lb (3.x.x.x)  31.2 ms
```
This matches policy precedence change.

lee (oncall-sre): Rollback in progress? Jin, ETA?

jin (prod-eng): Rolling back to route-policy-v1 now, hitting the revert command: `./route-control rollback --policy route-policy-v1 --env prod --reason "misroute rollout"`
Rollback started 03:28 UTC. Monitoring logs for ripple.

ops-bot: Deploy bot: rollback job started by jin (prod-eng) — job_id=rb-2026-03-15-317.

maria (neteng): Noted some DNS TTLs at 120s and legacy LB healthchecks cached. Even after rollback, a subset of requests will still hit us-east for ~2-5 minutes while caches expire. We'll need an active pin to restore for high-impact customers.

lee (oncall-sre): Action: immediate mitigation = 1) rollback policy (in flight) 2) apply temporary header-based region pin at edge for known enterprise customers 3) throttle route reconfig pushes until postmortem. Assigning tasks.

alex (sre): I'll own edge-header pins. Adding `X-Region-Pin: eu-west-1` for customer prefixes in WAF edge rules. Patch applied to eu-west-edge at 03:33 UTC.

maria (neteng): Confirming route-policy v1 active again as of 03:36 UTC per control plane. Network metrics show an egress shift back to eu-west over the next 4 minutes.

lee (oncall-sre): Monitoring request success rate and customer 5xxs. Sara, please start customer outreach for impacted enterprise tenants. We need an ETA and brief.

sara (customer-success): On it. I'll draft a short message to the top 10 affected accounts: what happened, mitigation steps taken, expected recovery window, and offer a 1:1 review. Will post a canned message for approval in ~10m.

maria (neteng): Final diagnostics: root cause was a race in the rollout controller where a retry loop accidentally expanded canary scope when a leader election timeout occurred. Policy semantics were fine, but rollout orchestration bug caused wide exposure.

lee (oncall-sre): Current status: rollback completed, edge pins applied, request error rate returning to baseline. No ongoing degradation for non-edge-cached traffic. We'll keep this thread open for handoff.

jin (prod-eng): Creating a tracking ticket: INF-3819 (rollback + root cause + controller fix). Plan: patch rollout controller to be idempotent and add rollout throttling safeguards. Target PR today, staging test tomorrow.

alex (sre): Post-incident: I'll remove the temporary header pins after TTLs settle (target 04:10 UTC) and verify with `curl` traces.

maria (neteng): Network note: we also observed BGP path preference shifts for a brief interval due to route redistribution timing. No netops manual change. Logging added to detect similar precedence flips.

lee (oncall-sre): Oncall handoff: I'm paged now but need to hand to Alex for overnight. Alex — please take follow-up and own postmortem write-up. I'll be on call for 30m overlap.

alex (sre): I accept handoff. I'll own postmortem, customer impact summary, and action tracking.

lee (oncall-sre): Estimated impact: ~2.3% of EU-origin requests experienced increased latency and ~0.7% transient 5xx spike over a 10m window. A handful of enterprise tenants reported degraded UX. Good job getting rollback fast.

sara (customer-success): Draft sent to customers and legal looped in for any contractual concerns.

ops-bot: Incident audit: created incident record inc-2026-03-15-17 with severity P1.

lee (oncall-sre): Next: Alex to publish preliminary incident note by EOD UTC, Jin to send PR for rollout controller fix, Maria to add network detection alerts. Closing active mitigation tasks; we will keep monitoring for 2 hours.

alex (sre): Will post the preliminary incident note to #postmortems and link this thread. Thanks everyone.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated — monitoring.

lee (oncall-sre): Closing my active pager. Handing off to alex for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
